name: Chimera, Orthrus
body:
Orthrus CR
4

This two-headed wolf-hound has a shaggy coat, dark sooty gray above and paler ashy gray on its underside, with a long serpentine tail ending in a third, snake-like head.

XP 1,200
LE Medium magical beast
Init +6; Senses all-around vision, darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 42 (5d10+15)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +2; +2 vs. blinded, charmed, deafened, stunned

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 bites +9 (1d6+3), tail sting +8 (1d4+3 plus poison)
Special Attacks rend (2 bites, 1d6+4 plus trip and 1d4 bleed)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 6, Wis 13, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +8; CMD 20 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +10, Perception +11, Stealth +10, Survival +9; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception
Languages Infernal (cannot speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ageless (Ex)

An orthrus cannot die or take penalties for old age or be aged magically.

Poison (Ex)

Tail sting—injury; save Fort DC 15; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hell)
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (2-12)
Treasure incidental

Orthruses were created by the same chthonic masters that created all chimeras as the male counterparts to their leonine cousins. However, after generations their monstrous brood grew too unstable and their creators adapted the chimeras to reproduce on their own. Orthruses found themselves no longer needed and even hated by these new chimeras, and so most retreated to the farthest reaches of the world, where the cruel chimeras would not hunt them down. There some still lurk, licking their wounds and seeking the occasional lone chimera to force themselves upon and mate with, spawning more of their kind with great wolves and waiting for the day they can rise against their oppressors.

Some orthruses have abandoned their dreams of vengeance and simply seek to live in plenty. These rare orthruses establish their own packs or even take up service with powerful masters like geryoneos, seeing in them a multi-headed kinship. These orthruses are typically neutral in alignment rather than neutral evil.
